documentation.summary: Curated sequence liability scan for protein and antibody design.  ProteinMPNN and friends optimise folding, not manufacturing. Report deamidation, isomerisation, oxidation and glycosylation sites.

readers.title: PLINK .tped genotype reader
readers.description: PLINK 1.9 .tped/.tfam hard-call genotypes.

documentation.summary: PLINK 1.9 transposed pedigree (.tped / .tfam) reader.  Reader for PLINK 1.9 transposed genotype files.  Each ``.tped`` row is ``chrom id cm pos`` followed by two allele codes per sample; ``.tfam`` lists the samples. Codes are ``0`` (missing), ``1`` (first allele) and ``2`` (second allele); the value stored for a call is the count of the first allele, so heterozygous calls are ``1``.

TSV reader.  Tab-separated two-dimensional tables. The first line is treated as a header by default; set ``header: false`` in args to read every line as data.  Compression (.gz, .bz2, .xz) is handled by pandas directly; this reader receives the original path.  Label rules accepted:  builtin           header row (valid only for the column dim) auto              position indices "0", "1", ... {<col_dim>: <k>}  read column <k>; its values become the row labels and the column is removed from data. `
